[[File:Gungan_High_Council.png|thumb|250px|The High Council in [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]].]]

The '''Gungan High Council''' was the governing body of the [[Gungan society]], under the leadership of a [[Boss/Legends|Boss]]. In the years prior to and following the [[Battle of Naboo/Legends|Battle of Naboo]], [[Rugor Nass/Legends|Rugor Nass]] was head of the High Council.

The primary membership of the High Council comprised [[Rep/Legends|Reps]], who worked with the Boss to determine policies and maintain order. For this reason, the High Council was sometimes known as the '''Rep Council'''. The Council met in the [[High Board Room/Legends|High Tower Boardroom]] in [[Otoh Gunga/Legends|Otoh Gunga]], though for a time after the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Invasion of Naboo]], it was forced to meet in the [[Gungan Sacred Place/Legends|Gungan Sacred Place]]. The Council assembled as and when the current Boss wished to discuss important matters, and Reps were personally chosen by the Boss.
